a.lede: Jensen Huang, who has come under fire for admitting to an affair with a woman accused of being a Chinese intelligence agent, has been accused of having a separate affair with an Nvidia subordinate.
a.title: Jensen Huang accused of having another affair — with an Nvidia exec

b.lede: Jensen Huang has been summoned to appear before Congress's Select Committee on the CCP.
b.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang summoned to Congress over affair with alleged Chinese spy
